text.tspan: I’m Chloe — I design how people talk to, understand, and
I spent four years at Samsung designing interactions for AI TVs, home robots, and connected devices. That
work made me curious about how technology should behave when it becomes part of everyday life.
I’m drawn to the small moments that shape our relationship with AI: when it speaks, when it stays quiet, and
how people know what it’s doing. I use research and prototyping to make those interactions easier to
I’m now studying Design Engineering at Harvard, where I’m exploring human–AI interaction beyond the
screen, especially in health and well-being.
Master in Design Engineering (MDE), studying complex systems, engineering,
and human-centered design at the Harvard John A. Paulson School of
Engineering and Applied Sciences and the Harvard Graduate School of Design.
UX Designer focused on Human-Robot Interaction, Conversational AI, and
multimodal experiences — designing intelligent systems that understand user
intent and enable more natural human-AI interactions.
Designed the product concept and service UX for an ESG-focused digital
platform, translating sustainability initiatives into user-centered digital
